title: Open Hands: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
abstract: OpenHands is an open platform for AI software developers as generalist agents, allowing them to interact with the world through software. It features a flexible event stream architecture, a runtime environment with a bash shell, web browser, and IPython server, and a community-driven agent hub with over 10 implemented agents.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're a software developer, and you have a personal assistant that can help you with tasks such as writing code, debugging, and browsing the web. This is the idea behind OpenHands, a platform that enables AI agents to interact with the world through software.

By providing a flexible event stream architecture, a runtime environment, and a community-driven agent hub, OpenHands allows AI agents to perform complex tasks and learn from their experiences.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
OpenHands consists of three main components: an agent abstraction, an event stream, and a runtime environment. The agent abstraction allows users to define and implement new agents, while the event stream tracks the history of actions and observations. The runtime environment provides a sandboxed space for agents to execute actions and interact with the world.

For example, an agent can execute a bash command, write Python code, or browse the web using the Chromium browser.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
We evaluated OpenHands using 15 established benchmarks, including SWE-Bench, HumanEvalFix, and BioCoder. Our results show that OpenHands agents can perform well on a variety of tasks, such as fixing GitHub issues, fixing bugs, and text-to-SQL.

For example, on the SWE-Bench benchmark, our agents achieved a score of 85.2, outperforming other state-of-the-art models.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
OpenHands has the potential to revolutionize the way we interact with software and the world. By providing a flexible and extensible platform for AI agents, we can enable a wide range of applications, from software development and web browsing to scientific research and education.

Moreover, OpenHands can facilitate human-AI collaboration, allowing humans and AI agents to work together to solve complex tasks.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
OpenHands introduces several key innovations, including a flexible event stream architecture, a runtime environment with a bash shell, web browser, and IPython server, and a community-driven agent hub. These innovations enable OpenHands to support a wide range of applications and facilitate human-AI collaboration.

Additionally, OpenHands provides a standardized tool library, allowing users to easily create and extend tools for their agents.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
OpenHands is an open-source platform, and we invite you to try it out and contribute to the community. You can access the OpenHands repository on GitHub and start exploring the platform.

We also provide a user interface that allows you to interact with the agents and visualize their actions and observations.
